product.schneider-euroat-ii.history: The December 1991 German price list offered the 16 MHz Euro AT II with a 42 MB disk for DM 1,732 net, including MS-DOS 5.0 and Windows 3.0. Schneider placed it in the Euro Line alongside the EuroSX and Euro486.
product.schneider-euroat-ii.technical.co: The service manual distinguishes two boards. It identifies 53 195 00 for 16 MHz and 53 457 00 for 20 MHz. The parts list specifies a 40 MB disk and the sales list specifies 42 MB.
product.schneider-euroat-ii.technical.ve: The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-euroat-ii.technical.li: The board still needs to be checked against a specimen and an attributed BIOS preserved. An image with clear publication rights remains pending.
product.schneider-euroat-ii.technical.so: CC SELLER / BC, Schneider Computer, 12/1991, pp. 1–3
Schneider, Service Manual Euro AT II / Euro 486 SX, PDF pp. 3–6
